# Vendor Renewals

Controls recurring vendor commitments so auto-renewals, price changes, unused subscriptions, and cancellation deadlines are actively managed.

## Renewal pack
Current contract/terms, renewal date, notice deadline, owner, current spend/usage, proposed price change, alternative options, performance/incidents, data/security classification, outstanding invoices, and termination/export requirements.

## Workflow
```text
Renewal window → usage/value/risk review → business owner decision → budget/finance check → security/privacy refresh if material → negotiate/accept/cancel → contract/payment details update → next date calendared
```

A vendor renewal is not automatic simply because a corporate card continues paying; recurring spend must have an accountable owner.
